body.cap: The booth of ZipShowKorea at Pre-CES2025 in Incheon (IFEZ). | Photo by AVING News

body.x: ZipShowKorea (CEO Phoenix Hong) participated in ‘Pre-CES2025 Incheon (IFEZ)’ on November 13 at the Grand Ballroom C of Songdo Convensia.

Specializing in immersive experience zones like online exhibition halls, VR, AR, 3D scanning, media walls, and live sketches, ZipShowKorea has built expertise through over 300 content projects. The company focuses on bringing innovative concepts to life and strives to achieve the best outcomes in all its projects.

At CES 2025, ZipShowKorea will unveil its 3D digital tablet, Color to Life. This tablet transforms user-colored drawings into 3D content displayed on a screen. Users can rotate 3D designs 360° for a multidimensional coloring experience. Being paperless, it contributes to environmental protection, while its user-friendly interface makes it accessible to people of all ages.

The company also showcased its AI Media Art Solution, which connects AI technology with art to create new experiences. Leveraging generative AI, this solution enhances creative expression by generating AI-crafted videos based on user choices. It enables high-quality content production at low costs and fast turnaround times, producing art that surpasses imagination. The solution was installed at the National Museum of World Writing Systems in 2023 and will be featured at the Sorae Historical Museum in December.

A representative from ZipShowKorea stated, “We decided to participate in CES 2025 to showcase our innovative content to a wider audience, network for global business expansion, and explore new collaborations and business opportunities with industry experts and partners worldwide. This is an excellent opportunity to understand the latest trends and advancements, which will help us refine our strategies, strengthen our competitiveness, and expand our international presence.”

Organized by the Incheon Free Economic Zone Authority (IFEZA) and Incheon Technopark, ‘Pre-CES2025 IFEZ’ is part of the ‘Global Top 10 City Incheon Week’ held in the third week of November. Integrating five related events, the event focuses on key themes like healthcare, bio, and smart cities. On November 13, the IFEZ Smart City Tech Conference and the CES2025 Incheon Pavilion showcase occurred concurrently.
